First, 49 weeks + 7 days = 49 × 7 + 7 = 343 + 7 = 350 days.  
Start date: 1483-02-08 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 8th February 1483).  
Add 350 days:  
1483 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but 1483 < 1582, using proleptic Gregorian).  
Days in Feb 1483 = 28, so from Feb 8: 28 − 8 = 20 days left in Feb → 20 days used.  
Remaining days to add: 350 − 20 = 330 days.  
March to December 1483:  
Mar(31)+Apr(30)+May(31)+Jun(30)+Jul(31)+Aug(31)+Sep(30)+Oct(31)+Nov(30)+Dec(31) = 306 days.  
330 − 306 = 24 days left → goes into next year 1484.  
1484 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
24 days into 1484: Jan 31 days → 24 days means Jan 24, 1484.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1484-01-24
